plan.goal: v0.0.2 — three paradigm-oriented features: inline editor, skill on/off toggles, Requests/Sub-Requests/Tasks tracking system.

active_assumptions: Policies auto-load like skills — scope creeping slightly past v0.01 spec but the user approved the pattern when it seeded the requests policy
Disabled-skills state lives in .rness/skills/.disabled (plain text, one name per line) — human-inspectable, editable outside the UI
Date format is YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM (sortable) not the user's original MM_DD_YYYY-HH-MM — user approved the switch
Mark-done is a UI action (button on preview chrome), not an agent action — user's approval act by design
continuation_prompt: v0.02 shipped. Things the user may hit in testing: (1) agent may forget to update an active request file across turns — a lightweight nudge in the policy or an in-chat 'active request: X' indicator could help; (2) edit mode has no conflict detection (last-write-wins if user and agent race on the same file); (3) the '.disabled' file is invisible in the default file tree (hidden-dotfile filter) — users may not realize it exists without reading docs; (4) request detection relies on model judgment — low-capability models may under-create or over-create request files. Don't build pre-emptively; see what actually bites in use.
